articles.title: Parachuting Doctors Land on a Tiny Island to Save a Sick Man!
articles.summary: British Army medics jumped from a plane onto Tristan da Cunha, one of the most remote islands on Earth, to help a man with a rare virus. They brought oxygen and supplies because the island has no airport.

articles.title: Cruise Ship Passengers Finally Go Home After Scary Virus Outbreak!
articles.summary: After weeks stuck on a ship with a rare virus called hantavirus, passengers from the MV Hondius are being flown home from Spain. They wore special suits and were sprayed with disinfectant to keep everyone safe.

articles.title: Big Shake-Up in UK Politics: A Warning for the Prime Minister!
articles.summary: After a terrible election, a top Labour politician says the party must change or it's their 'last chance.' She wants a popular mayor to join Parliament, adding pressure on Prime Minister Keir Starmer.
